reason: I don't hand my money to an app nobody has heard of, with zero reviews and a broker partner that isn't even named yet. And a Tamagotchi running my portfolio feels like a toy, not something I'd trust with real dollars.
objection: No track record, no reviews, no known name, and no licensed broker signed yet. Letting an AI move real money for me needs a serious brand behind it, and a cartoon pet tells me the opposite.
would_change_my_mind: A well-known licensed broker named as the partner, plus a year of solid reviews from real-money users, including a couple of finance creators I follow vetting it.
